target.title: fix(google): add timeout to Vertex ADC token refresh
target.body:
Related: #95865

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Google Vertex `authorized_user` Application Default Credentials token refresh can wait indefinitely when the OAuth token endpoint accepts the request but never sends a response.

## Why This Change Was Made

Vertex ADC token refresh already bounds the token response body after a response arrives, but the fetch itself had no deadline. This change adds a 30s token-refresh request timeout while preserving the existing ADC credential lookup, token cache, token-expiry handling, and bounded response-body parsing.

## User Impact

Operators using Google Vertex with local `authorized_user` ADC get a bounded authentication failure instead of a stuck provider request when the Google OAuth token refresh HTTP request stalls after connection acceptance.

## Collision / Differentiation Check

Open PRs touch the same Vertex ADC file, so this PR is intentionally narrow and differentiated:

- #98507 bounds token response body reads to prevent OOM after a response arrives; this PR bounds the request before any response arrives.
- #101035 supports `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID`; this PR does not alter project/env resolution.
- #91222 handles transient pre-stream failures and stale ADC retry behavior; this PR does not add retry behavior.

## Evidence

- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/vertex-adc.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  1 passed (1)`.
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/google/vertex-adc.ts extensions/google/vertex-adc.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` - passed; exit 0.
- Mutation check: temporarily bypassing the token-refresh deadline signal made the focused test remain pending instead of rejecting; restoring the patch returned the test to green.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Google Vertex authorized_user ADC token refresh now has a deadline when the OAuth token endpoint accepts the HTTP request but never responds.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; real `node:http` loopback server that accepts the token-refresh request and never responds, driving the real exported `resolveGoogleVertexAuthorizedUserHeaders` path with real ADC credentials written to a temporary file.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/vertex-adc.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused test first proves a token-refresh fetch without the passed deadline signal stays pending against the hanging loopback server; then the real patched path forwards the deadline signal and rejects with an abort/timeout-class error after the server receives `/token-with-deadline`.

Observed result after fix: `Test Files  1 passed (1)` and `Tests  1 passed (1)`.

What was not tested: a live Google OAuth token endpoint or live Vertex request; the hang is reproduced with a real local HTTP server, not the real third-party service.
